title: 0701 · Class Question Q2 — Resize and Rehash
markdown:
### 0701 · Class Question Q2 — Resize and Rehash

**老师原题**：*If a hashtable's array is resized to reduce collisions, what must be done to the elements that have already been inserted?*

- **A.** All items must be copied over to the same indices in the new array.
- **B.** Items must be rehashed and reinserted in the new array.
- **C.** The existing items can be placed anywhere in the new array.
- **D.** The hash function must be updated.

**正确答案：B。** 容量从 `m` 改变后，原 Key 的初始 Hash Index 和 Collision Resolution 结果可能改变；必须基于新表参数重新计算位置并重新插入，而不是直接把旧 Array 下标复制过去。

**易错点**：D 不是所问的必需操作。如果 Hash Function 本身写成可接收新容量参数 `h_m(k)`，调整 `m` 后不一定要重写函数代码；但旧 Entries 仍必须重新 Hash / Reinsert。**Key、Value、Note/Question ID 与 ReviewEvent 均不应因为表的理论 Resize 示例而变化。**

**来源**：CIS 223 0701 Poll Everywhere Q2；[Class Questions 原题](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1UyDQRbvoQQqbPMaakmcLbr_WwHBQcTKG4PFEReUqn8E/edit)。
